gui.justreactors.mode.passive_tooltip: Passive Mode: outputs FE directly via Reactor Power Taps. Add a Coolant Port to switch to Active Steam mode.
gui.justreactors.mode.active_tooltip: Active Mode (Coolant Port installed): boils Water into Steam for Turbines instead of generating FE directly.
gui.justreactors.heat_tooltip: Passive FE scales with casing temp. Active mode boils Water > 100 °C. Fuel above 1,000 °C burns slightly faster.
gui.justreactors.rpm_tooltip: Current: %s RPM (Peak coil efficiency around 900 & 1,800 RPM)
tooltip.justreactors.reactor_controller: Brain of the Reactor multiblock (3x3x3 to 32x32x32).
tooltip.justreactors.reactor_coolant_por: Right-click to toggle Inlet / Outlet. Inlet takes Water (makes Steam) or Coolant (makes Hot Coolant for a Heat Exchanger). Buckets fill it directly.
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_controller: Brain of the Steam Turbine multiblock (min 5x4x5).
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_fluid_port: Right-click to toggle Steam Inlet / condensed Water Outlet.
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_redstone_po: Configurable Redstone automation port for Steam Turbines.
tooltip.justreactors.cyanite_reprocessor: Reprocesses 2 Cyanite + 1,000 mB Water + 20,000 FE into 1 Blutonium Ingot.
gui.justreactors.turbine.vent_tooltip: Controls excess condensed Water: Overflow voids extra water when full, All dumps all water immediately, Disabled stalls steam intake if the tank is full.

jei.justreactors.info.reactor_controller: Brain of the Reactor multiblock (3x3x3 to 32x32x32). Edges must be Reactor Casing; vertical Fuel Rod columns must be topped by Control Rods. Add a Reactor Coolant Port to switch to Active Steam mode.
jei.justreactors.info.reactor_coolant_po: Right-click to toggle Inlet / Outlet. Adding a Coolant Port switches a Reactor to Active Cooling. Water boils into Steam for turbines; Coolant comes out as Hot Coolant for a Heat Exchanger.
jei.justreactors.info.turbine_controller: Brain of the Steam Turbine multiblock (min 5x4x5). Place one Rotor Bearing on a wall with a straight Rotor Shaft to the opposite wall, Rotor Blades along the shaft, and metal/gem Coils around the shaft.
jei.justreactors.info.turbine_redstone_p: Controls a Steam Turbine via Redstone (ON/OFF, Coils, Analog Steam Flow) or emits Redstone based on RPM or Energy Buffer thresholds.
jei.justreactors.info.cyanite_reprocesso: Reprocesses 2 Cyanite Ingots, 1,000 mB Water, and 20,000 FE into 1 Blutonium Ingot, which can fuel a Reactor again.
advancements.justreactors.root.title: Just Reactors

gui.justreactors.rpm_tooltip_hint: Coils are most efficient around 900 and 1,800 RPM (gold marks).
gui.justreactors.tip.fuel.title: Core Fuel Status
gui.justreactors.tip.core.title: Core Temperature
gui.justreactors.tip.casing.title: Casing Temperature
gui.justreactors.tip.casing.hint: Passive FE scales with casing temperature. In Active mode, the casing boils Water into Steam above 100 °C.
gui.justreactors.tip.energy.title: Energy Buffer
gui.justreactors.tip.water.title: Water
gui.justreactors.tip.steam.title: Steam
gui.justreactors.tip.turbine_water.hint: Condensed from spent steam. Send it back to the reactor to close the loop.
gui.justreactors.tip.rotor.title: Rotor Speed
gui.justreactors.tip.coils.hint: Engaged coils turn rotor speed into FE. Disengage them to let the rotor spin up.
gui.justreactors.tip.flow.hint: Maximum steam the turbine takes per tick. Use -100 / +100 to adjust.
gui.justreactors.tip.progress.title: Reprocessing
gui.justreactors.tip.burn.hint: Fuel burned per tick. Insert the control rods to burn less and run cooler.
tooltip.justreactors.heat_exchanger_cont: Cools the reactor's Hot Coolant back into Coolant and boils Water into Steam with that heat. Build a box of Casing (edges), Glass and ports with Tubes inside.
tooltip.justreactors.heat_exchanger_flui: Right-click to cycle Input (Hot Coolant + Water) / Coolant Output / Steam Output.
tooltip.justreactors.heat_exchanger_tube: Goes inside a Heat Exchanger. Each tube adds cooling throughput.
tooltip.justreactors.battery_controller: Multiblock FE storage. Build a box of Casing (edges), Glass and ports with Battery Cells inside. Charges and drains FE items.
tooltip.justreactors.battery_power_port: Right-click to toggle Input / Output. Output ports push FE to neighbours.
tooltip.justreactors.battery_redstone_se: Emits redstone from the battery wall based on the charge level.
tooltip.justreactors.battery_cell: Goes inside a Battery. Each cell adds storage and transfer rate.
message.justreactors.multiblock.too_smal: Structure must be at least %s blocks on each side.
message.justreactors.multiblock.edge_mus: Edges and corners must be Casing (at %s, %s, %s).
message.justreactors.multiblock.missing_: The structure needs exactly one controller.
message.justreactors.heat_exchanger.no_c: Place at least one Heat Exchanger Tube inside.
message.justreactors.battery.no_core: Place at least one Battery Cell inside.
gui.justreactors.heat_exchanger.tube_rat: Up to %s mB/t of Hot Coolant
gui.justreactors.heat_exchanger.steam_ra: Steam: %s mB/t (%s per mB of Hot Coolant)
gui.justreactors.tip.coolant.title: Coolant
gui.justreactors.tip.hot_coolant.title: Hot Coolant
gui.justreactors.tip.hot_coolant.hint: Send it to a Heat Exchanger, which cools it back into Coolant and boils Water into Steam.
gui.justreactors.tip.reactor_coolant.hin: Water boils into Steam. Coolant carries more heat per mB and comes out as Hot Coolant.
gui.justreactors.tip.exchanger_coolant.h: Cooled Coolant, ready to go back to the reactor through a Coolant Output port.
gui.justreactors.tip.exchanger_water.hin: Water is boiled 1:1 into Steam. Return a turbine's condensed water here to close the loop.
gui.justreactors.tip.tubes.hint: More tubes cool more Hot Coolant per tick and enlarge the tanks.
gui.justreactors.tip.exchanger_flow.hint: Limited by the tubes, the Hot Coolant and Water supply, and free space for Coolant and Steam.
gui.justreactors.tip.battery_ports.hint: Input ports accept FE from cables; Output ports push FE to their neighbours. Each port moves up to the max rate.
gui.justreactors.tip.battery_cells.hint: Each cell adds storage and transfer rate. Removing cells shrinks the capacity and loses the excess.
gui.justreactors.tip.charge_slot.hint: FE items here are charged from the battery.
gui.justreactors.tip.discharge_slot.hint: FE items here are drained into the battery.
jei.justreactors.heat_exchanging.ratio: 1 mB Hot Coolant boils %s mB of Water
jei.justreactors.heat_exchanging.tube: %s mB/t of Hot Coolant per Tube
jei.justreactors.info.heat_exchanger_con: Closes the reactor's coolant loop. Feed Hot Coolant and Water into an Input port; take Coolant back to the reactor from a Coolant Output port and Steam to a turbine from a Steam Output port. More Tubes inside means more throughput.
jei.justreactors.info.coolant: Put Coolant into a reactor's Coolant Port instead of Water. It carries more heat per mB, leaves as Hot Coolant, and a Heat Exchanger turns it back into Coolant while boiling more Steam than the reactor would boil directly.
jei.justreactors.info.battery_controller: A box of Battery Casing (edges), Glass, Power Ports and Redstone Sensors around Battery Cells. Every cell adds capacity and transfer rate. The terminal's top slot charges FE items, the bottom slot drains them, and a comparator next to it reads the charge.
jei.justreactors.info.battery_redstone_s: Place it in the battery wall. Emits a signal when the charge is above or below a threshold, full or empty. Wire it to a reactor or turbine Redstone Port to run generators only when the battery needs power.
message.justreactors.carryon.assembled: Assembled machines can't be carried. Break the structure first.
